summary.summary: Les McCoy called back after missing prior outreach and was transferred to Raven to review next steps for an upcoming roofing project at 6933 W Linda (zip 85338). The rep confirmed the other job on the account was already completed and paid, verified Les’s contact details, and confirmed there are no blackout dates in the next 4–6 weeks (customer prefers to start as soon as possible). Raven explained the scope as a foam one-inch silicone roof installation, noted materials will be brought the day of install, and that the job typically takes 1–3 days depending on roof size and weather; the customer does not need to be home but should be reachable by phone. The rep also reviewed arrival window (7–9 AM), driveway clearance, the final walkthrough and job completion form required to release warranty documents, and advised the customer to expect a mailed pre-lien notice from Titan Lien Services that does not require signature. Les had no questions and expressed strong satisfaction with prior work and confidence in the upcoming job.
